summary.content:
Today's selection covers 63 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 36 on Artificial Intelligence and 11 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Experiment: Porting a PLC Exploit With AI Takes Hours and Hundreds of Dollars
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Ransomware Gang Claims Nutex Health Data Breach
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from SecurityWeek, Dark Reading, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, BBC Technology and others
• **Fresh Content**: 37 articles published in the last 24 hours
